text:
Ruth: Requesting tactical unfreeze for EU slice to push v3.4.1-hotfix (OOM fix). Target change window 12:30-13:00 UTC. Need greenlight from SRE and QA. /cc @Anika @Jon
Anika: Noted. I'll run a quick checklist and post status. Need: canary path, smoke script, rollback pin, capacity headroom.
Jon: I can run the canary and smoke. Canary plan: 5% on eu-west-1, observe for 5m. Rollback if errors > 2% or p95 > 500ms.
Priya: QA will run smoke against canary once it's up. ETA ~6m.
Ruth: Tactical unfreeze only for the hotfix subgroup — minimal blast radius. No other PRs in this window.
Anika: Prechecks: infra autoscaler healthy :white_check_mark:, downstream latencies normal :white_check_mark:, DB replicas caught up :white_check_mark:, circuit-breakers nominal :white_check_mark:.
Anika: Capacity headroom: GPUs spare 18% (threshold >=15%) :white_check_mark:.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot received unfreeze request from Ruth. Initiating canary rollout: v3.4.1-hotfix -> eu-canary-01 (5%).
deploy-bot: Canary started — initializing containers, warming caches, attaching traces.
Jon: Running smoke script now:
```
# smoke.sh
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://eu-api.redwood.dev/generate" -d '{"prompt":"smoke test","max_tokens":5}'
```
Priya: Smoke OK on canary: HTTP 200, p95 120ms, sample responses look sane. No regressions observed.
Anika: Monitoring for 5m. Abort criteria: errors > 1% (hard) or p95 > 500ms (soft + triage).
Ruth: :thumbsup: If stable at 5m we'll lift the freeze for the subgroup and proceed to 50% then full.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics @5m: errors 0.12%, p95 128ms, tokens/sec nominal — marking canary healthy.
Jon: Proceeding to 50% ramp now.
deploy-bot: Rolling to 50%... complete. Traffic redistributed.
Priya: Post-roll smoke at 50% green — response shapes and edge cases look fine.
Anika: Approved to lift freeze for this subgroup. Rollback decision recorded: immediate pin to v3.4.0 and traffic rollback command: `./roll_traffic_back.sh eu 100` if we hit abort thresholds.
Ruth: Confirming no legal/security approvals needed — no data-plane schema changes. Proceed.
Jon: Scheduling final ramp to 100% in 2 minutes.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% complete. v3.4.1-hotfix is live in eu.
Ruth: Thanks team — I'll update the release notes and mark the freeze-lift event on the calendar.
Anika: Note added: watch embeddings path for cost delta over next 24h (observability alert runbook ready).
Priya: I'll open a short post-deploy regression checklist and ping if anything flakey shows up.
Ruth: :tada: Great work, team.
